--app-bytes.help: reassembled application bytes to force (default: 4,097, enough to overflow a 4 KiB BinPAC::flowbuffer_capacity_max; use 9,000,000 for a stock-cap reproducer)

--bad-count.help: number of bad-cookie messages between the valid ones

--body-len.help: actual body bytes to send before closing (default: 100)

--cc.help: Number of CC TO command lines (default: 3)

--client-port.help: Client source port (default: random ephemeral port)

--length.help: Length of VIA path in SIP session (default: 100)

--pad-options.help: pad options carried by each bad-cookie message

--paths.help: Number of Received: (mail path) header lines (default: 1)

--rcpt.help: Number of RCPT TO command lines (default: 3)

--to.help: Number of To: header lines in the message (default: 1)
